original_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '8.1'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY mNum ASC
question_en: Show the resolution-count trend for agenda item 8.1 over time (topic-activity trend).
reference_query:
MATCH (m:Meeting)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m)
WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (r)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '8.1'}) }
WITH m, count(DISTINCT r) AS resolutionCount
RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingOrdinal, resolutionCount
ORDER BY meetingOrdinal ASC
